name: Submitted card
summary: The calm "submitted, waiting for the reveal" card: the frosted deck surface with the ink hairline, a round pip (or the picked option's image), a heading and a muted subtitle.
highlights: Frosted card that reads on any deck
Glyph pip or the picked image
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-submitted-card> — for the audience phone of a slide type (a cross-origin iframe on the Developer Platform). Framework-free, loaded by URL from the version-pinned CDN with tokens.css, so a build-less page imports it instead of copying CSS. The deck colours arrive as data in a cross-origin iframe, so call `applyDeck(root, xprops.slide)` from `audience-deck` once (or set `ink` / `accent` on the element). Every audience element inherits the deck font.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) binds events through a ref; Vue binds the custom element natively.

spec.label: Card
spec.value: radius 12, padding 24, gap 16, frosted surface, 1px ink hairline

spec.label: Pip
spec.value: 64px circle on a 10% ink wash, 32px glyph; or a 96px image, radius 8

spec.label: Text
spec.value: 16px semibold heading; 16px subtitle in the ink at 75%

props.name: ink
props.desc: The deck ink (xprops.slide.textColour) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: accent
props.desc: The deck accent (presentationColorPalette[0]) for this element only; normally inherited from applyDeck()

props.name: heading / subtitle
props.desc: "Submitted: Dogs" / "Wait for the presenter to reveal the answer" (translated)

props.name: icon
props.desc: The pip glyph, from the DS icon library

props.name: image
props.desc: The picked option's image, shown in place of the pip

whenToUse.when: after the participant has locked in, until the presenter reveals

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP), on the light-deck example with no deck applied (DS defaults).
conformance.measure: (function(){var el=document.querySelector('aha-submitted-card[data-probe]');var r=el&&el.shadowRoot;function q(s){return r&&r.querySelector(s)}function cs(n){return n?getComputedStyle(n):{}}var c=cs(q('.card'));var h=cs(q('.heading'));return{radius:c.borderTopLeftRadius,padding:c.paddingTop,ink:h.color,headingSize:h.fontSize,pip:cs(q('.pip')).width};})()
